position: Senior Director, Customer Success at Oracle NetSuite
about:
ERP and portfolio and project management software specialist with a focus on professional services, account management and business operations. Ability to deliver complex enterprise software solutions that provide rapid ROI for clients who seek to leverage technology to execute their strategic initiatives such as in IT, Business PMOs, and Merger & Integration initiatives.

Over 12 years of experience managing professional services teams to implement SaaS portfolio and project management and ERP software. Ability to work with prospects and sales teams to develop compelling statements of work and solutions to win new business. Manage 20+ consultants, project managers, technical resources and customer success managers to get customers live and ensure their continued success.

Global Vice President of Customer Success
experiences.description: Voxware helps organizations with teams who are on the move more effectively receive, act on, and communicate critical information. By employing its hands-free voice solutions, employees safely, accurately, and quickly complete tasks, thereby increasing productivity while reducing costly errors.

Director, Professional Services for NetSuite, the world's leading provider of cloud-based business management software. NetSuite helps companies manage core business processes with a single, fully integrated system covering ERP/financials, CRM, ecommerce, inventory, and more.

Responsibilities:

 1) Achieve and exceed professional services revenue and profitability objectives
 * Ensure team billable utilization targets are met
 * Manage project portfolio to ensure quality, on-time and on-budget implementations using a mix of global resources

 2) Responsible for adhering to highest quality standards in project delivery
 * Manage executive-level customer relationships and provide team oversight through NetSuite's ERP and e-Commerce implementations
 * Responsible for project staffing and resource scheduling on a broad range of consulting engagements

 3) Support sales and customer success functions to sell into existing accounts and ensure renewals.
 * Collaborate with various departments to resolve system issues and improve customer satisfaction

 4) Hire, train, and manage team of new and experience resources to fulfill Practice objectives
 * Provide coaching and mentoring to assist in resources'​ career development
 * Build team's expertise and confidence in project delivery work
 * Handle day-to-day administrative tasks such as: vacation scheduling, expense reports, time entry, etc.

experiences.position: Director of Professional Services and Customer Success
experiences.description:
*  Responsible for developing and presenting end-to-end web-based solution to meet Fortune 1000 corporation's portfolio management, merger and integration, and Six Sigma needs.
*  Manage pre-sales requirements and prototyping process.  Responsible for completing RFI and RFP responses. 
*  Pre-sales efforts in 2003 led to a 200% revenue increase with key sales at Tyco International, EMC, PepSico, Department of Defense and the U.S. Army.  
*  Lead enterprise deployments at Fortune 1000 companies including Tyco International, State Street Bank, General Electric, Pitney Bowes, Navy, OSD, Ecolab, JCI, US Army, and Merck.     
*  Coordinate customer enhancements and application service provider renewals for defined client base.
*  Liaison between clients and technical teams for issue resolution, product upgrades, and software maintenance releases.
*  Manage a team of up to 30 professional services resources that conduct enterprise implementations and add on professional services to a global customer base/

*  Sales engineer for Siebel and SalesLogix prospects and responsible for demonstrating solutions to meet client's needs and budget.
*  Formulate presentations, proposals, and return on investment analysis to obtain new accounts and add on business to existing accounts.
*  Interface between client and internal team when software, application hosting, and account challenges arise.
*  Responsible for overall account profitability for implementations, enhancements, and application hosting services

	Conduct needs analysis with current and prospective clients to design and to develop clients prospect data management solutions including online registration, financial processing and reports.    
	Perform sales engineer function for organizations web-based campaign management solution and conducted initial deployments at Computer Associates, Silicon Graphics, Tivoli, and AutoDesk.  
	Successfully negotiated and signed over $6 million in renewal contacts exceeding management business objectives.
